name: Endless Samurai
description:
About This Game

One Strike. Total Tension.

A Parry-Driven Japanese Roguelite.

Endless Samurai is a turn-based action RPG built around precision parries.
With its roguelite structure, every run unfolds differently—inviting you to return, refine, and conquer.

◆ The Thrill of the Perfect Parry

Guard at the very last moment to trigger a parry.

Fail—and suffer heavy damage.
Succeed—and unleash a devastating counterattack.

That razor-thin line between risk and reward defines the heart of Endless Samurai.
Tension. Impact. Release.

◆ Strategy at the Core: Turn-Based Combat

Every action advances the turn.

When the enemy’s countdown reaches zero, they strike.

The key question is simple:
What will you do before they attack?

Careful planning, ability timing, and resource management shape each encounter.
Because the timing is visible, you can brace yourself—
and commit fully to the parry.

This is controlled tension.
A battle decided by foresight.

◆ Where Strategy Meets Speed

Despite its turn-based foundation, combat feels fast and fluid.

Responsive controls.
Seamless parry-to-counter transitions.
Momentum that builds with every decision.

You may find yourself acting instinctively—only to realize the enemy’s turn is approaching.
Mastering the rhythm between calculation and action is where true exhilaration lies.

◆ A World of Japanese Pixel Art

A romantic, stylized world inspired by Japanese aesthetics and brought to life in pixel art.

You ascend toward the summit of the demonic paradise, Tougenkyo,
facing powerful yokai and warriors along the way.

Each character carries their own beliefs and motives,
adding depth to both story and battle.

◆ Choice, Randomness, and Endless Runs

In battle, you are constantly forced to choose.

Select one upgrade from multiple options and shape your build.
Weapons grant unique skills—how and when you use them determines survival.

Branching paths appear unexpectedly.
Adapt to your situation and choose wisely.

Every element carries randomness.
No two runs are ever the same.

Even in defeat, permanent upgrades remain.
Fall, grow stronger, and rise again—
until you finally reach the summit.
short_desc: One Strike. Total Tension. A Japanese parry-driven roguelite that blends turn-based depth with fast-paced action. Master the parry. Control the battle.
